requirement: When vehicle speed exceeds 120 km/h, the system shall display an overspeed warning.
reference_given: Vehicle speed is at or below 120 km/h.
reference_when: Vehicle speed increases above 120 km/h.
reference_then: The system displays the overspeed warning.

requirement: When battery SOC falls below 10% while the vehicle is in Drive, the system shall display a low-battery warning.
reference_given: The vehicle is in Drive and battery SOC is at or above 10%.
reference_when: Battery SOC falls below 10%.
reference_then: The system displays the low-battery warning.

requirement: When battery temperature exceeds 50°C, the system shall activate battery cooling.
reference_given: Battery temperature is at or below 50°C and cooling is inactive.
reference_when: Battery temperature rises above 50°C.
reference_then: The system activates battery cooling.

requirement: If vehicle speed is greater than 5 km/h, the charge-port door shall not open.
reference_given: Vehicle speed is greater than 5 km/h and the charge-port door is closed.
reference_when: A request to open the charge-port door is received.
reference_then: The charge-port door remains closed.

requirement: When AC charging is active and the charging connector is removed, the system shall terminate the charging session.
reference_given: AC charging is active and the charging connector is connected.
reference_when: The charging connector is removed.
reference_then: The system terminates the charging session.

requirement: When the ignition state changes from OFF to ON, the instrument display shall initialize.
reference_given: Ignition is OFF and the instrument display is not initialized.
reference_when: Ignition changes from OFF to ON.
reference_then: The instrument display initializes.

requirement: When tire pressure falls below 28 psi, the system shall display a low tire pressure warning.
reference_given: Tire pressure is at or above 28 psi.
reference_when: Tire pressure falls below 28 psi.
reference_then: The system displays a low tire pressure warning.

requirement: When coolant temperature exceeds 105°C, the cooling fan shall be commanded ON.
reference_given: Coolant temperature is at or below 105°C and the cooling fan is OFF.
reference_when: Coolant temperature rises above 105°C.
reference_then: The cooling fan is commanded ON.

requirement: When the brake pedal is pressed, the brake lamp output shall be activated.
reference_given: The brake pedal is not pressed and the brake lamp output is inactive.
reference_when: The brake pedal is pressed.
reference_then: The brake lamp output is activated.

requirement: When the driver presses the hazard switch, all turn indicator lamps shall flash.
reference_given: Hazard lamps are inactive.
reference_when: The driver presses the hazard switch.
reference_then: All turn indicator lamps begin flashing.

requirement: When DC fast charging is active and battery SOC reaches 80%, the system shall reduce the requested charging power.
reference_given: DC fast charging is active and battery SOC is below 80%.
reference_when: Battery SOC reaches 80%.
reference_then: The system reduces the requested charging power.

requirement: The system shall enter Sleep mode if ignition is OFF and no network activity is detected for 300 seconds.
reference_given: Ignition is OFF and the system is awake.
reference_when: No network activity is detected continuously for 300 seconds.
reference_then: The system enters Sleep mode.

requirement: When a valid wake-up message is received while the controller is in Sleep mode, the controller shall enter Active mode within 100 ms.
reference_given: The controller is in Sleep mode.
reference_when: A valid wake-up message is received.
reference_then: The controller enters Active mode within 100 ms.

requirement: When a sensor signal remains outside its valid range for more than 2 seconds, the system shall set the corresponding diagnostic fault.
reference_given: The sensor signal is within its valid range and no corresponding fault is set.
reference_when: The sensor signal remains outside its valid range for more than 2 seconds.
reference_then: The system sets the corresponding diagnostic fault.

requirement: If three consecutive CAN messages are missed, the system shall set a communication timeout fault.
reference_given: The expected CAN message is being monitored and no timeout fault is active.
reference_when: Three consecutive expected CAN messages are missed.
reference_then: The system sets a communication timeout fault.

requirement: When the driver door is open and vehicle speed exceeds 3 km/h, the system shall issue an audible warning.
reference_given: The driver door is open and vehicle speed is at or below 3 km/h.
reference_when: Vehicle speed increases above 3 km/h.
reference_then: The system issues an audible warning.

requirement: The system shall inhibit propulsion when the charging connector is detected as connected.
reference_given: The charging connector is not connected and propulsion is available.
reference_when: The charging connector becomes connected.
reference_then: The system inhibits propulsion.

requirement: When a charging request is received and the connector is locked successfully, the system shall enable charging.
reference_given: A valid charging connector is attached, charging is disabled, and the connector is not yet locked.
reference_when: A charging request is received and the connector locks successfully.
reference_then: The system enables charging.

requirement: When inverter temperature exceeds 90°C, the system shall reduce the maximum available motor torque.
reference_given: Inverter temperature is at or below 90°C and maximum motor torque is available.
reference_when: Inverter temperature rises above 90°C.
reference_then: The system reduces the maximum available motor torque.

requirement: If the seat belt is unlatched while the occupied driver seat is detected and vehicle speed exceeds 10 km/h, the system shall activate the seat-belt reminder.
reference_given: The driver seat is occupied, the seat belt is unlatched, and vehicle speed is at or below 10 km/h.
reference_when: Vehicle speed increases above 10 km/h.
reference_then: The system activates the seat-belt reminder.

requirement: If battery voltage is below 300 V for at least 500 ms while the high-voltage system is active, the system shall set a low-voltage diagnostic fault.
reference_given: The high-voltage system is active, battery voltage is at or above 300 V, and the low-voltage fault is not active.
reference_when: Battery voltage remains below 300 V for at least 500 ms.
reference_then: The system sets the low-voltage diagnostic fault.

requirement: A low-voltage diagnostic fault shall not be set if battery voltage returns to 300 V or higher before the 500 ms debounce period expires.
reference_given: The high-voltage system is active and battery voltage falls below 300 V.
reference_when: Battery voltage returns to 300 V or higher before 500 ms has elapsed.
reference_then: The system does not set the low-voltage diagnostic fault.

requirement: The system shall accept a received command only if its checksum is valid and its message age is less than 100 ms.
reference_given: A command message is available for validation.
reference_when: The system evaluates a command with a valid checksum and message age below 100 ms.
reference_then: The system accepts the received command.

requirement: If an isolation fault is detected while propulsion is enabled, the system shall disable propulsion and request high-voltage shutdown.
reference_given: Propulsion is enabled and no isolation fault is active.
reference_when: An isolation fault is detected.
reference_then: The system disables propulsion and requests high-voltage shutdown.

requirement: If battery temperature is below -20°C, DC fast charging shall remain inhibited even when a valid charging request is present.
reference_given: Battery temperature is below -20°C and DC fast charging is disabled.
reference_when: A valid DC fast charging request is received.
reference_then: DC fast charging remains inhibited.

requirement: After receiving a valid shutdown request, the system shall disable the actuator output within 50 ms.
reference_given: The actuator output is enabled.
reference_when: A valid shutdown request is received.
reference_then: The system disables the actuator output within 50 ms.

requirement: If accelerator pedal sensor 1 and sensor 2 differ by more than 10% for longer than 100 ms, the system shall set a pedal plausibility fault.
reference_given: Both accelerator pedal sensors are valid and their difference is 10% or less.
reference_when: The sensor difference exceeds 10% continuously for more than 100 ms.
reference_then: The system sets a pedal plausibility fault.

requirement: When battery SOC is below 15% and cabin preconditioning is requested while the vehicle is unplugged, the system shall reject the preconditioning request.
reference_given: Battery SOC is below 15%, the vehicle is unplugged, and cabin preconditioning is inactive.
reference_when: A cabin preconditioning request is received.
reference_then: The system rejects the preconditioning request.

requirement: When a diagnostic fault is active, the system shall store a freeze-frame containing battery voltage, battery SOC, vehicle speed, and controller temperature at the time the fault is confirmed.
reference_given: The monitored diagnostic fault is not yet confirmed.
reference_when: The diagnostic fault becomes confirmed.
reference_then: The system stores a freeze-frame containing battery voltage, battery SOC, vehicle speed, and controller temperature from the confirmation time.

requirement: If any prerequisite for high-voltage contactor enablement becomes invalid before contactor closure is confirmed, the system shall abort the contactor closing sequence.
reference_given: The high-voltage contactor closing sequence has started but closure is not yet confirmed.
reference_when: The service disconnect opens, the interlock loop becomes invalid, or an isolation fault is detected.
reference_then: The system aborts the contactor closing sequence.
